about.value: Located in Bearden Tennessee near Knoxville, Bearden Hill Fieldhouse offers over 100 bottles and 20 beers on tap. Craft Beer, Wine and Full Liquor, a Diverse Menu, Wing Specials. Poker Nights, and Trivia.
